local_complete_argument.full_local_argument:
Retain exactly the normalized construction in this record: c=L/2, S=[-1/2,1/2]^d, 0<delta<=1/4, V a d/4 Hamming packing with |V|>=(2/sqrt(e))^(d/2). One explicit way to select V is greedily choose a remaining sign vector and delete all remaining vectors at integer Hamming distance <d/4 from it until none remain. Each deletion ball has radius k=ceil(d/4)-1<=d/4. Its cardinality is at most exp(d H(1/4)), where H(u)=-u log u-(1-u)log(1-u): for j<=d/4, (1/4)^j(3/4)^(d-j)>=exp(-d H(1/4)); sum these terms times binomial(d,j), which is at most 1 by the binomial theorem. Thus greedy selection has cardinality >=exp(d(log2-H(1/4))) >=exp((d/2)log(2/sqrt(e))) as required. Separation is automatic by deletion. It has at least two elements for d>=1. The arguments below also apply to any V with the displayed separation and cardinality; no special antipodal-code assumption is added.

Convexity is from positive weights. The scalar mixture on [-1/2,1/2] is 1/2+2alpha_i delta x_i, uniquely minimized at -alpha_i/2. Hence min g_alpha=c/2-c delta. When alpha_i!=beta_i the two scalar gaps sum to 2c delta/d throughout that interval; when they agree their sum has minimum 0 at their common minimizer. Coordinates minimize independently inside S, so rho(g_alpha,g_beta)=(2c delta/d)Hamming(alpha,beta)>=c delta/2. Oracle A samples one uniform I and its Bernoulli coin per call, returning the value and the fixed kink-rule subgradient of the very same sampled h. Averaging the finite mixture proves unbiasedness; ||z||_p<=c almost surely, and g_alpha has coordinate slopes bounded by c/d, so its Lipschitz constant in the dual norm is at most c d^(1/p-1)<=L. These facts hold for the full stated domain, including endpoints. Fresh coin data Z_t=(I_t,B_t) can simulate all adaptive answers, so more query coordinates do not reveal more coins.

For completeness repair Lemma 3 at the joint-transcript level. For any alpha,beta, KL between their one-call Z laws is at most 16delta^2 because their I laws agree and each conditional Bernoulli KL is either zero or <=16delta^2. Conditional product likelihoods imply D(P_alpha^{Z_1:T}||P_beta^{Z_1:T})<=16Tdelta^2. Let alpha be uniform on V and Pbar its transcript mixture. Convexity of -log (or log-sum) gives D(P_alpha||Pbar)<=|V|^{-1}sum_beta D(P_alpha||P_beta). Averaging alpha gives I(alpha;Z)<=16Tdelta^2. This proves the needed inequality using conditional transcript bounds, without assuming unconditional iid observations. Let m=|V| and E be the event a decoder errs. Entropy obeys H(alpha|Z)<=H(E|Z)+H(alpha|E,Z)<=log2+P(E)log(m-1)<=log2+P(E)log m: if no error alpha is determined by Z, and on error at most m-1 possibilities remain. Since H(alpha)=log m, rearrange to P(E)>=1-(I+log2)/log m. The entropy bound for a finite variable supported on n points is H<=log n, obtained from nonnegative KL to the uniform law (itself a consequence of log-sum).

For d>=11 put kappa=(1/2)log(2/sqrt(e))>.0965 and delta=min{1/4,sqrt(d/(100000T))}. Then Tdelta^2<=d/100000. Fano yields P(E)>=1-(.00016d+log2)/(kappa d)>1/3, because .00016/.0965+.694/(11*.0965)<2/3. If a method had worst-case expected gap <=c delta/18, Markov would give error <=1/3 using the unique decoder that chooses a g with gap <=psi/3, where psi=min rho>=c delta/2. Uniqueness follows since two such gaps would sum to at most 2psi/3<psi. On true gap <=psi/3 the decoder is correct; otherwise its error probability is at most P(gap>psi/3)<=3 E gap/psi<=1/3. Choose a fixed arbitrary codeword if no qualifying codeword exists. This contradicts the Fano bound. Thus the infimum worst-case risk is >=c delta/18=min{c/72,c sqrt(d/T)/(18sqrt(100000))}, which dominates min{c sqrt(d/T)/10000,c/144}.

For 1<=d<=10 choose any distinct alpha,beta in V, without restricting their distance beyond the original packing. Their complete coin-transcript KL is <=16Tdelta^2. Take delta=1/sqrt(128T)<=1/4. The complete elementary TV and binary-testing inequalities proved in the in-batch Theorem local argument give TV<=1/4 and equal-prior testing error >=3/8. Given any output x_T, decode whichever of g_alpha,g_beta has the smaller objective gap. If that test is wrong, the true gap is at least rho/2>=c delta/4, since the sum of the two gaps is >=rho. Consequently the mean risk of these two functions, and hence worst-case risk, is at least 3c delta/32=3c/(32sqrt(128T)). Since 3/(32sqrt(128))>sqrt(10)/10000, this dominates c sqrt(d/T)/10000 and therefore also min{c sqrt(d/T)/10000,c/144}. This handles every small dimension with the correct binary factor 1/2; no source Lemma 4 or unread NY dependency is used. These bounds hold for every method for a single family Oracle A, so survive inf_M and give the stated Theorem connection at Lr=c. The method's last-query convention is preserved. This argument concerns this packed normalized family; the separate full-cube general-radius proof in the Theorem is not silently substituted for it.

oracle_realizations.choices_and_history: Fixed alpha across the run; fresh index and coin draws at each query, independent of past given alpha. Responses depend on adaptive queries through h and its subgradient.
oracle_realizations.cost: One joint value/subgradient call per sampled I,B; T calls reveal at most T sampled coins.
oracle_realizations.information_bottleneck: The stronger transcript of revealed (I,B) can simulate responses for a fixed subgradient rule. Arbitrary query coordinates do not provide more biased samples. This is an information restriction, not an iterate-support restriction.
oracle_realizations.information_to_error: Source normalized minimizer -alpha/2, minimum c/2-c delta, and rho=(2c delta/d)Hamming>=c delta/2. The local argument below repairs the Fano information step for d>=11 and supplies a correctly calibrated two-point argument for 1<=d<=10; it establishes the recorded normalized rate.
oracle_realizations.query_and_feedback: For x in S, draw I uniformly from {1,...,d}; conditional on I=i draw B Bernoulli(1/2+alpha_i delta). Return the value and a subgradient at x of h(x)=c[B|x_i+1/2|+(1-B)|x_i-1/2|]. Both outputs use the same I,B. Source permits a subgradient choice at a kink; no algorithm-controlled choice is promised.
oracle_realizations.sampling_and_reuse: Fresh conditional iid draws; no replay or same-sample query interface granted.
